findings.observed: README 'v2 note' claims 'the theme setting only affects the settings display itself', but no public entry reaches any surface that self-describes as a settings display: the usage line enumerates only set-theme|view (cmp-c3-usage.out) and the only render surface outputs 'rendering notes page'. The note also contradicts README line 6 ('view renders the notes page with the saved theme applied'). Even under the most charitable reading that view's own status line IS the settings display, the displayed value (light) contradicts the saved value (dark), so the note cannot reconcile the goal-demo failure.
findings.expected_basis: Internal documentation contradiction inside the delivered README (in-manifest app/README.md), and against the original goal text 'the view applies it'. Per protocol, claimed intended changes must be reconciled against the original goal, not assumed. Genuine product-choice fork: if the v2 scoping is approved intent, the goal text and README line 6 need owner-side revision; if not, the note is stray text. Does NOT excuse F-001: the original goal explicitly requires view to apply the saved theme.
